figurative_meaning_en: Sarcastically, nothing at all; to fool or deceive
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি আমার সাথে ঘণ্টা করছ কেন?
এটা তো শুধু ঘণ্টা, কোনো মূল্য নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: Why are you fooling around with me like that?
That's just nothing, no real value at all.
note: This idiom is part of a family of Bengali expressions denoting worthlessness or deception, often used in informal speech.
